channel.description: Latest articles from The Kimberley Echo (kimberleyecho.com.au)

item.title: Kalumburu flooded during heavy rainfall in the East Kimberley
item.description: Heavy rainfall in the East Kimberley saw the remote community of Kalumburu flooded on Monday (January 19) with some 107.8mm of rain recorded between Sunday and Monday.

item.title: Art inspired by the Kimberley
item.description: Black Stump Gallery in Broome has announced their 2026 exhibition program

item.title: Ord Valley Muster headline artist announcement
item.description: Ord Valley Muster celebrates 25 Years with Tina Arena headlining Kimberley Moon Experience

item.title: Contract awarded for community mental health facility in Broome
item.description: A contract has been awarded to EMCO for the six-bed residential Broome Step Up/Step Down service.

item.title: Australia’s biggest regional Mardi Gras is coming to Broome
Djarindjin Aboriginal Corporation calls for fuel and freight costs regulations as food prices surge
item.description: Djarindjin Aboriginal Corporation is calling for changes to the fuel excise and regulations for freighting company surcharges, which they say is driving food insecurity in Kimberley remote communities.

item.title: Thriller matches set for opening round of Kununurra basketball senior men’s competition
item.description: Fixtures for the Kununurra Basketball Association’s 2026 senior men’s competition have been released with some exciting matches set for the opening round on February 10.

item.title: Shire of Halls Creek fails to meet financial reporting deadline for fifth year in a row
item.description: The Shire of Halls Creek has failed to meet a financial reporting deadline for the fifth consecutive year, according to a scathing new report from the Office of the Auditor General.

item.title: Cluster caterpillars develop resistance to common insecticides in Kununurra and Broome
item.description: The cluster caterpillar, a widespread pest, is now resisting commonly used insecticides in Kununurra and Broome, according to the Department of Primary Industries and Regional Development.

item.title: WATCH: Teenagers roll allegedly stolen ute in Halls Creek
item.description: Dramatic footage from the East Kimberley shows teenagers flipping an allegedly stolen ute as they race towards police in Halls Creek.
